description:
Over the last 2+ years, I’ve worked as a career counsellor, guiding 105+ candidates across MBA, Engineering, and Literature paths.
Alongside, I run a YouTube channel sharing practical insights on careers, MBA life, and decision-making.
I am an alumnus of IIM Kozhikode, where I strengthened my understanding of business and product thinking.
I am working as a Product Manager, in leading NBFC building products at the intersection of users, technology, and business. 
Before my MBA, I spent 1.5 years at BEL as an EVM Engineer, working on large-scale public systems.
I hold an Electronics & Communication Engineering degree from PTU.
College also shaped my voice—I worked as a Radio Jockey, learning the art of communication early on.
Catch me on https://www.linkedin.com/in/shubhangiaryan
And YT channel: https://youtube.com/@shubhangi_says
